evidence.finding: Local browser workspace for CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, shell) with projects, live status, resume, search, Task Manager, output previews, CliDeck Ask, plugins; localhost only; MIT; Node 22.12+.

evidence.title: MIT license
evidence.finding: MIT License text.

evidence.title: package.json
evidence.finding: Version 2.6.0, bin clideck, Node >=22.12, node-pty, ws, xterm.js, mermaid; no cloud SDK dependencies.

evidence.title: CLI definition
evidence.locator: usage(): agents, ask, show, prompt, annotate, plugins, plugin install
evidence.finding: CLI exposes session discovery, ask/steer, preview, prompt, annotate and plugin commands to agents and users against the local engine URL.

evidence.title: Agent session guide
evidence.finding: Product-supplied instructions tell each agent session to discover peers with clideck agents, ask idle peers, steer working ones and coordinate file ownership.

evidence.title: Ask routing
evidence.finding: Resolves a target session or project, requires an idle target or --steer, with 10-minute default and 60-minute max timeout.

evidence.title: Provider registry
evidence.finding: Seven providers: claude-code, antigravity, codex, gemini, opencode, pi and shell.

evidence.title: WebSocket origin checks
evidence.finding: Only same-host origins are accepted and loopback-bound servers accept loopback origins only.

evidence.locator: Version 2.6; Removed features; Old agent hooks
evidence.finding: v2 removed Autopilot, mobile control, LAN binding and legacy plugins; imports v1 data into ~/.clideck-next; removes obsolete v1 agent hooks with private backups.

evidence.title: Backup and restore
evidence.locator: Settings > General > Backup & restore; Automatic recovery
evidence.finding: Backup downloads JSON with settings, projects and session definitions; selective restore; not conversations or files; includes custom command env values.

evidence.title: Session archives
evidence.finding: Optional archive of conversation events as JSONL in a user-chosen folder.

evidence.title: Plugin SDK
evidence.finding: v2 plugin SDK with folder-based plugins under the data directory, CLI commands and settings.

evidence.title: Git Changes plugin
evidence.finding: Read-only panel showing uncommitted and since-base changes for a session repository or worktree; never stages or commits.

evidence.title: Context usage
evidence.finding: Shows per-session context-window usage (used tokens, window, percent) for supported agents; no cost data.

evidence.title: Task Manager
evidence.finding: Lists agent process trees with CPU and memory per project and lets the user stop a job (macOS and Linux).

evidence.title: Update check
evidence.finding: Only outbound product request found: bounded npm registry check for a newer version; nothing is installed automatically.

evidence.title: Claude hook settings

evidence.title: PTY launcher
